name: Use Case Diagram — E-Commerce System
description: Use Case Diagram describes external actors and the functional goals they want to achieve when interacting with the system. This diagram helps define the scope of requirements and boundaries of the e-commerce system.
purpose: Define the scope of requirements and system boundaries between customers and the development team.
bestFor: Define scope between customer and development team
Basis for writing user stories or test cases
Describe system functions at a high level for stakeholders
useCases: Identify actors: Customer, Admin, Payment Gateway
Identify use cases: Login, Place Order, Payment, Product Management
Set up include/extend: «include» Authenticate, «extend» Apply Coupon
Draw system boundary around the use cases
requirements: REQ-001: System allows customers to log in with email/password
REQ-002: System allows customers to place orders and make payments
REQ-003: System allows admin to manage products (add, edit, delete)
REQ-004: System allows customers to look up order history
REQ-005: System must authenticate identity before allowing order placement
